'''Csaba Schmidt''' (3 May 1979 – 19 March 2023)<ref name="Biography">{{cite web |url=http://www.parlament.hu/kepv/eletrajz/hu/s101.pdf |title=''Biography'' |publisher=[[National Assembly of Hungary|Országgyűlés]] |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140204011552/http://www.parlament.hu/kepv/eletrajz/hu/s101.pdf |archivedate=2014-02-04 }}</ref><ref>[https://hvg.hu/itthon/20230320_meghalt_Schmidt_Csaba_tatabanya_volt_polgarmestere Meghalt Schmidt Csaba, Tatabánya volt polgármestere] {{in lang|hu}}</ref> was a Hungarian chemist and politician, [[National Assembly of Hungary|member of the National Assembly]] (MP) from [[Fidesz]] [[Komárom-Esztergom County]] Regional List between 2010 and 2014.<ref name="Register">{{cite web|url=http://www.parlament.hu/internet/plsql/ogy_kpv.kepv_adat?p_azon=s101&p_ckl=39|title=''Register'' |publisher=[[National Assembly of Hungary|Országgyűlés]]}}</ref> He was [[2010 Hungarian local elections|elected]] mayor of [[Tatabánya]] on 3 October 2010.<ref name="Biography"/>

He was a member of the Committee on Sustainable Development from 14 May 2010 to 5 May 2014 and Committee on Local Government and Regional Development from 23 September 2013 to 5 May 2014.<ref name="Register"/>
